mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active and does not require specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a tightening monetary policy, it increases the cost of capital and reduces corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random walk in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A strengthening labor market, indicated by rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE, signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The joint effect of both series is necessary for the signal to be active.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., positive returns in < 60% of triggered instances) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate economic overheating, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 12-month moving averages (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random walk in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production, indicated by INDPRO falling below 100 for two consecutive months, signals an imminent economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A stronger labor market, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates higher employment and consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is always active and does not require specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 12-month average (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction between these two demand indicators is necessary for the signal.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 12-month moving averages fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., positive returns in < 60% of triggered instances) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive policy action, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random walk in 60% of triggered instances.
